name: Style
description: Represents a style description for a range.
remarks: The Style object contains all style attributes (font, number format, alignment, and so on) as properties. There are several built-in styles, including Normal, Currency, and Percent. Using the Style object is a fast and efficient way to change several cell-formatting properties on multiple cells at the same time. For the Workbook object, the Style object is a member of the Styles collection. The Styles collection contains all the defined styles for the workbook. You can change the appearance of a cell by changing properties of the style applied to that cell. Keep in mind, however, that changing a style property affects all cells already formatted with that style. Styles are sorted alphabetically by style name. The style index number denotes the position of the specified style in the sorted list of style names. Styles(1) is the first style in the alphabetic list, and Styles(Styles.Count) is the last one in the list. For more information about creating and modifying a style, see the Styles object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if text is automatically indented when the text alignment in a cell is set to equal distribution (either horizontally or vertically).

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: True if the style is a built-in style. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents the borders of a style or a range of cells (including a range defined as part of a conditional format).

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.

properties.name: FormulaHidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the formula will be hidden when the worksheet is protected.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlHAlign value that represents the horizontal alignment for the specified object.

properties.name: IncludeAlignment
properties.description: True if the style includes the AddIndent, HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment, WrapText, IndentLevel, and Orientation properties of the Style object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeBorder
properties.description: True if the style includes the Color, ColorIndex, LineStyle, and Weight properties of the Border object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeFont
properties.description: True if the style includes the Background, Bold, Color, ColorIndex, FontStyle, Italic, Name, Size, Strikethrough, Subscript, Superscript, and Underline font properties. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeNumber
properties.description: True if the style includes the NumberFormat property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludePatterns
properties.description: True if the style includes the Color, ColorIndex, InvertIfNegative, Pattern, PatternColor, and PatternColorIndex properties of the Interior object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeProtection
properties.description: True if the style includes the FormulaHidden and Locked protection properties. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IndentLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the indent level for the style.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object that represents the interior of the specified object.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the object is locked.

properties.name: MergeCells
properties.description: True if the style contains merged cells. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: NameLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the object, in the language of the user. Read-only String.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlOrientation value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: ShrinkToFit
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if text automatically shrinks to fit in the available column width.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the specified style.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlVAlign value that represents the vertical alignment of the specified object.

properties.name: WrapText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if Microsoft Excel wraps the text in the object.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the reading order for the specified object. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right-to-left), xlLTR (left-to-right), or xlContext. Read/write Long.
